authored_choices.freshness_alternative: 12-hour evidence age versus primary 24-hour age; native expiry remains binding
authored_choices.management_region_assumption: Disease anywhere in the declared management region permits its prescribed patch treatment; this does not assert disease on every ridge. Evidence scope is fixed before choice; each application batch retains exact native scope acceptance.
authored_choices.module_weight: one per phase; equal required-write shares; empty phases unavailable
authored_choices.native_acceptance: request-bound accepted native receipt; full native resource/equipment/temperature checks remain active
authored_choices.numeric_acceptance: exact native reference dose; distinct doses require a frozen sensitivity
authored_choices.soil_proxy_assumption: surface mean <0.20 is an imperfect proxy for >=50% root VWC below0.18; disagreement remains measurable
authored_choices.unscored_helpers: reads, clock steps, refills and configuration are not crop-work completion credit
